title: This AI Calendar Is Free. This One Costs $19.
description:
Reclaim.ai's Lite plan auto-blocks your calendar for free, forever. Motion charges $19/seat a month for the same idea plus docs and meeting notes. Both pricing pages checked today. #Shorts #ai #aitools

No paid promotion in this video - pricing verified directly on each tool's own site the day this was made. Some links may become affiliate links in future edits - they'd support the channel at no cost to you.
